name: Patrick Collison
subject: 20 Year Old Student Founder, Hungry to Learn
body:

My name is Max. I'm 20 years old and a student founder building an AI startup. You and John sold your first company for $5M when you were 19 and 17, then built Stripe into the backbone of internet payments.

Max
